next_rating.history: three consecutive actual numeric ratings t-2,t-1,t
next_rating.target: next observed scheduled minute t+1; no crossing gaps
next_rating.weighting: equal eligible window loss, uncertainty resamples whole people
next_rating.direction: predicted versus current VAS; decrease or no decrease

symptoms.selection: source field names and existing dictionary; no inferred Rome diagnosis
symptoms.statistics: marginal category counts and cooccurrence of explicit symptom/location binary indicators

motifs.method: observed nearest segment to each complete-case kmeans cluster mean; display only
motifs.role: representative observed motif, not discriminatively trained shapelet or clinical label

inference_calibration.purpose: null type-I error engineering evaluation; target QC gate remains separate
